clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following months: your mother was worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents grew distant by November with your father working late most nights, you developed stomach aches and began missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah and father had shouting matches by May, and your mother stopped going back to her job by September. Each shift in these months follows the next, and no one else's shows outside this period.
